about_us_section.short_description: We believe online shopping should be simple, affordable, and accessible to everyone. By partnering directly with trusted suppliers, we offer a wide selection of quality products at competitive prices, supported by secure payments, transparent shipping, and reliable customer service.
about_us_section.meta_title: About Us | Our Story, Vision & Commitment
about_us_section.meta_description: Discover our story, vision, and commitment to affordable and reliable service, and a great shopping experience.

our_story.story_1: Our journey began with a simple question: why should customers pay extra for unnecessary layers in the supply chain? By embracing the dropshipping model and partnering directly with reliable suppliers, we streamline the purchasing process, reduce overhead, and pass those savings on to our customers through more affordable prices.
our_story.story_2: Our mission goes beyond offering lower prices. We strive to build a shopping experience based on transparency, reliability, and long-term customer satisfaction. From carefully selected suppliers to secure payments and responsive support, every part of our service is designed with our customers in mind.
our_story.story_3: Every order is an opportunity to earn our customers' trust. We're committed to continuously improving our store, expanding our selection, and providing an experience defined by honest communication and dependable support.

why_choose_us.description: We're committed to making your shopping experience simple, secure, and enjoyable.
why_choose_us.reason_1_description: Our direct supplier network helps reduce shipping costs while providing estimated delivery times before you place your order.
why_choose_us.reason_2_description: Your payments are protected using secure and trusted payment providers.
why_choose_us.reason_3_description: By working directly with trusted suppliers, we reduce unnecessary costs and offer quality products at competitive prices.
why_choose_us.reason_4_description: Our support team is here to answer your questions and help with your orders.

our_mission.text_1: Our mission is to make online shopping more affordable by connecting customers with carefully selected products while reducing unnecessary intermediaries. By streamlining the purchasing process, we can offer competitive prices without compromising on quality or security.
our_mission.text_2: We believe everyone deserves access to quality products at fair prices. That's why we're committed to transparent pricing, reliable shipping options, secure payments, and responsive customer support throughout every step of your shopping experience.

contact_us_section.description: We're here to help! Reach out to us with any questions or concerns, and we'll be happy to assist you.
contact_us_section.meta_title: Contact Us | Get in Touch with Our Support Team
contact_us_section.meta_description: Have a question about an order, product, delivery, or payment? Contact us and we'll be happy to help.

faq_section.description: Find answers to the most common questions about orders, shipping, payments, returns, and customer support.
faq_section.meta_description: Find answers to common questions about Goosak products, orders, delivery, payment methods, tracking, returns, and customer support.

question_1.question: How long does shipping take?
question_1.answer: Delivery times depend on the selected shipping method and destination country. Estimated delivery dates are displayed during checkout before you place your order.

question_2.question: How can I track my order?
question_2.answer: Once your order has been shipped, you'll receive a tracking number by email. You can also use our Order Tracking page to check the latest delivery status.

question_3.question: What payment methods do you accept?
question_3.answer: We accept major credit and debit cards along with other secure payment methods available during checkout.

question_4.question: Can I return an item?
question_4.answer: Yes. If your order is eligible for return, you can submit a return request according to our Returns & Refund Policy.

question_5.question: When will I receive my refund?
question_5.answer: Approved refunds are processed using the original payment method. Processing time depends on your payment provider and may take several business days.

question_6.question: How can I contact support?
question_6.answer: You can reach our support team through the Contact Us page or by emailing us directly. We'll respond as quickly as possible during business hours.

shipping_section.description: Everything you need to know about shipping, delivery estimates, and tracking your order.
shipping_section.shipping_coverage_description: We ship to most countries around the world. Available shipping options are shown during checkout based on your delivery address.
shipping_section.shipping_delivery_time_description: Delivery time depends on your destination and the shipping method you choose. Estimated delivery dates are displayed before you complete your purchase.
shipping_section.shipping_cost_description: Shipping costs are calculated automatically during checkout based on your destination, selected shipping method, and the items in your cart.
shipping_section.shipping_tracking_description: Once your order has been shipped, you'll receive a tracking number by email so you can follow your package until delivery.

returns.description: We want you to shop with confidence. Below you'll find information about returns, refunds, and what to do if there's an issue with your order.
returns.return_eligibility_description: Eligible items may be returned according to our return policy. Products should be unused and returned in their original condition whenever possible.
returns.refund_process_description: Once your return has been received and approved, your refund will be issued using the original payment method. Processing times may vary depending on your payment provider.
returns.return_damage_description: If your order arrives damaged or you receive the wrong item, please contact us as soon as possible so we can resolve the issue quickly.
returns.return_help_description: If you have any questions about returns or refunds, our support team is always happy to assist you.

track_order.description: Enter your tracking number to check the latest status of your order
track_order.alert_message: We couldn't find tracking information for the number you entered. Please check that the tracking number is correct. If your order was placed recently, tracking details may not be available yet. Older or expired shipments may also no longer have tracking information. If you need assistance, please contact our support team.

payment_methods_section.description: We offer secure and reliable payment options to make your checkout experience simple and safe.
payment_methods_section.meta_title: Payment Methods | Secure Ways to Pay
payment_methods_section.meta_description: Learn about the secure payment methods available at Goosak and choose the most convenient way to pay for your order.
payment_methods_section.accept_description: We accept major credit and debit cards as well as other secure payment methods available during checkout.
payment_methods_section.secure_description: Your payment information is protected using encrypted connections and trusted payment providers. We never store your complete payment card details.
payment_methods_section.charge_description: Payment is processed securely during checkout after you confirm your order.
payment_methods_section.currencies_description: Available currencies are displayed throughout the store. The final payment amount is shown before you complete your purchase.

privacy_policy_section.description: Your privacy is important to us. This page explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you use our website.
privacy_policy_section.collect_description: We collect only the information necessary to process your orders, provide customer support, and improve your shopping experience.
privacy_policy_section.use_description: Your information is used to process orders, communicate with you about your purchases, and provide customer support. We do not sell your personal information.
privacy_policy_section.security_description: We use secure technologies and trusted service providers to help protect your personal information during transmission and storage.
privacy_policy_section.rights_description: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, update, or request the deletion of your personal information. Please contact us if you have any questions regarding your privacy.

terms_section.description: These Terms & Conditions outline the rules and conditions for using our website and purchasing products from our store.
terms_section.use_website_description: By using our website, you agree to comply with these Terms & Conditions and all applicable laws and regulations.
terms_section.orders_description: All orders are subject to product availability and confirmation. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel orders when necessary.
terms_section.payments_description: Product prices and shipping costs are displayed during checkout. Payments are processed securely through our trusted payment providers.
terms_section.limitation_description: We strive to provide accurate information and reliable service, but cannot guarantee that our website will always be error-free or uninterrupted.

cookie_policy_section.description: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, how we use them, and the choices you have regarding their use on our website.
cookie_policy_section.meta_description: Learn how Goosak uses cookies and similar technologies to improve your browsing experience and provide better services.
cookie_policy_section.what_description: Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help websites remember your preferences and improve your browsing experience.
cookie_policy_section.use_description: We use cookies to keep the website functioning properly, remember your preferences, improve performance, and better understand how our website is used.
cookie_policy_section.manage_description: Most web browsers allow you to manage or disable cookies through your browser settings. Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality.
cookie_policy_section.your_privacy_description: We respect your privacy and use cookies responsibly. For more information about how we handle your personal data, please see our Privacy Policy.

call_to_action.description: If you need assistance or have any questions about our products, shipping, or your order, we're here to help.
